record.itemText: "The powder continues to shift within the pouch, as if it were still alive."^w^n(Applied to rings and amulets)
"Western nomads have long known that layered silk can envelop and slow the penetration of piercing projectiles."^w^n(Used in shoulder, chest and leg armor)
"A stone etching of an ancient protective symbol."^w^n(Used in amulets and medals)

record.FileDescription: %dmg absorb + projectile deflect + reduced player dmg
record.skillBaseDescription: A rare defensive technique of arcane magic invented by the revered Arcanist Maiven. Creates a protective shield around the caster, but at a great cost in concentration.

record.FileDescription: aura grants elemental dmg + energy leech
record.skillBaseDescription: Iskandra taught her students that the most efficient path of victory was to turn an opponent's own energies against them. Just so, Elemental Exchange causes the weapons of allies to hungrily absorb arcane energy from foes and return it in the form of elemental damage.
Call upon the beast god, Mogdrogen, to bestow nature's blessing upon you and your nearby allies.
Become one with Ultos, god of the sky, turning your mortal form into a conduit for the destructive power of lightning storms.
Focusing the mind and body into a locus for arcane energies is one of the first meditative techniques taught to aspiring Arcanists.
The incantation becomes overloaded with arcane forces, causing your weapons to crackle with the raw powers of the elements.
Strike a finely-tuned balance within your incantation, harmonizing the opposing forces of fire and ice with wild electricity.
The wild spirit of nature flows through your veins, rapidly sealing wounds and cleansing poisons.
Take on the aspect of ancient trees, solemn ageless titans that have outlived civilizations, bestowing additional protection upon those under Mogdrogen's blessing.
Conditioning of the body and mind to withstand the corrupting power of raw magic.
Attunement to the primal call of the wilds.
